description: A .NET implementation of the Milter protocol for writing Postfix and Sendmail mail filters in C#: callbacks per SMTP event, validated actions, a source generator that derives the protocol negotiation, Native AOT compatible.
rules: Implement IMilterContext as a partial class and override only the callbacks you need; there is no base class, no attribute and no libmilter-style smfi_* API.
Callbacks return ValueTask<CommitAction> built by CommitActions; OnEndOfBody returns IAsyncEnumerable<Action>: ModificationActions, then exactly one commit action.
Modify a message only from OnEndOfBody. Build every action through CommitActions or ModificationActions; the action records cannot be constructed directly.
Leave the six requirement properties to the bundled source generator; declare one by hand only after MILT002 or MILT003, or to override what it derived.
A context instance serves one message, not one connection. Pass a Func<TContext> factory to Milter<TContext>; it is AOT-safe and must be thread-safe.
Write OnEndOfBody as an async iterator and alias Action: using Action = Josupeit.Mail.Milter.Action; net8.0 has no built-in ToAsyncEnumerable.
Read src/Josupeit.Mail.Milter/llms-full.txt for exact signatures before writing code; do not infer members that are not listed there.
